en: i want the best hospitals available
i want treatment in the uk
i want to keep the same policy if i relocate
el: να κρατήσω το ίδιο συμβόλαιο αν μετακομίσω

positioning.framing_note: When HNWI signals are detected, adjust language toward 'Private Client Recommendation' / 'comprehensive international protection' / 'priority: choice, continuity and global access' — without becoming flashy or salesy. This changes tone and CTA label only. It must never change which plans are eligible or their price — that remains entirely the deterministic engine's decision.
positioning.not_only_expats_note: HNWI/affluent need for IPMI is not limited to people relocating internationally. An affluent local resident may want the same breadth of choice, limits and continuity.
